rows.detail: Native low-latency transport, browser datagram path, and reliable browser/fallback path. QUIC/WebTransport accept production PEM TLS; native clients verify public CA certificates and hostnames, while WebSocket uses WSS through a reverse proxy. Hand-rolled RUDP is deliberately not shipped.
